english:
Blocking damage with a Glaive or Sword grants 'Resist x4' for 3 seconds after you stop guarding. The buff grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resistance.

Raising your guard refreshes the buff's duration.

source.text:
4 Piece | Stesso Tempo

Upon blocking damage with a Glaive or a Sword:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4) for 3 seconds upon no longer guarding. 
Damage Resist can be reset by blocking and dropping the guard before buff expires.
